entry.title: SpaceX Starship Deploys Starlink Craft During Post-IPO Test
entry.summary: SpaceX’s Starship deployed upgraded Starlink satellites and returned to Earth largely unscathed, advancing Elon Musk’s IPO-fueled plans to scale his dominant rocket business into an artificial intelligence and satellite communications empire.

entry.summary: “Halting this merger while our case proceeds is a critical victory," NY AG said.

entry.title: SpaceX at $100 Would Imply Zero AI Value, Morgan Stanley Says
entry.summary: The selloff in SpaceX shares has driven the stock near a level that would imply investors are assigning no value to its artificial intelligence business, according to analysts at Morgan Stanley.

entry.title: SoftBank Weighs Deal for Robotics Startup Gravis
entry.summary: SoftBank Group Corp. is considering an acquisition of Gravis Robotics AG, people familiar with the matter said, as the Japanese investor targets the artificial intelligence technologies underpinning robotics.

entry.title: Robotics Startup Genesis in Talks to Raise About $500 Million
entry.summary: AI robotics startup Genesis AI is in talks with investors to raise around $500 million in a new funding round, according to people familiar with the efforts.

entry.title: South Africa Fund Plans $609 Million VC Raise With Exits Rising
entry.summary: A key South Africa fund plans to raise as much as 10 billion rand ($609 million) in venture capital to help scale high-growth startups, a move that would expand its technology sector and accelerate the development of one the continent’s most mature startup markets.

entry.title: The Week’s 10 Biggest Funding Rounds: Physical AI Startup Atoms Leads In Varied Week For Large Deals
entry.summary: Startup investors poured capital into a varied lineup of large rounds this week, targeting sectors including physical AI, biotech, cybersecurity, AI infrastructure and fintech.

entry.title: ServiceNow Posts Strong Sales and Bookings, Touts AI Strength
entry.summary: ServiceNow Inc. reported better-than-expected quarterly sales and bookings, boosting Wall Street’s hopes that the software maker’s new artificial intelligence tools will spur growth.

entry.title: Alphabet Posts Cloud Sales Beat, Slight Miss on Search Revenue
entry.summary: Alphabet Inc. reported second-quarter cloud revenue that surpassed Wall Street’s expectations but slightly missed on sales tied to its search-engine business, threatening to fuel concerns about its heavy spending on artificial intelligence.
